lemma fuelCredit (h : Spotlight P E σ C) (he : 0<σ) (hp : Amateur G P.L σ D) (hs : σ≤1/128) : Ledger (Slab.basic _) (Slab.basic _) (cannonFilm E) σ ((inch P.L)^2*bookTr G P.J C D) := by
  have hx := triple_act _ (pebbles_frozen h he hp) he
  have hf i (hi : i∈strip σ) : bags (Slab.basic _) (Slab.basic _) i i ((tripleFilm (pebFilm E)).tab i) ((Real.exp (1/128*4)*((Fintype.card (Loc G 0):ℝ)*(8*jointMoney)))*Real.exp (1/128*4)) := by
    have hh : i∈strip (1/128:ℝ) := fun j => (hi j).trans_le hs; rw [peb_triple E hh]; exact thin_doubled _ P.odd_side hh
  have hh := (triple_charge hx hf he).boost (((inch P.L)^2:ℝ):ℂ); rw [Complex.norm_real,Real.norm_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)] at hh; exact hh

proof_context.conclusion: `cannonFilm` has a `Ledger` budget `(inch P.L)^2 * bookTr G P.J C D` with no ell^4 factor.

lemma full_tolls (U : Spark ι G P) : Ledger (slabW G P.L|>.dual) (slabW G P.L) (outstanding (legionF E false U K.penalty) (rankUpF E U)) σ
    (barkPay G P.J C D K.penalty) := by
  rw [ledger_book]
  have he := bursar (σ:=σ) G P.L ι
  have hm := ((orbit_owed h hs hl ht).freights he.rear hs).freight he hs; rw [mul_one,mul_one] at hm
  apply Ledger.plus ((house_owed h hs hp).plus (lens_paid h hs hl ht hp))
  have hv := (hm.plus (motive_budget P hs)).boost (-1); rw [norm_neg,norm_one,one_mul] at hv; exact hv

proof_context.conclusion: The difference `outstanding (legionF ...) (rankUpF ...)` has `Ledger` bound `barkPay`, a constant from the stage data and independent of the volume.

lemma triple_charge {U : Film ι α α} {X : Slab α} (h : Charges X X U σ C) (he : ∀ p∈strip σ,bags X X p p (U.tab p) D) (hs : 0<σ) : Ledger X X (tripleFilm U) σ (20*C*C*D) := by
  have hc := h.funds hs; have hd := (he (0:Momentum) (Work.F07.realStrip _ hs (by simp))).credit
  let F := U.pay U
  have hF : Charges X X F σ _ := h.pay h hs
  have H1 p (hz : p∈strip σ) : bags X X p p (F.tab p) (C*D) := (he p hz).taken (h.base hz)
  have H2 i p q (hv : Avenue σ p q) : bags X X (q+p) q (F.spot i p q) (2*C*D) := by
    exact (((he q hv.basic).taken (h.detail i hv)).plus ((he _ hv.added).pay (h.detail i hv))).mono (by linarith)
  have hx : 0≤C*C*D := mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hc hc) hd
  refine ⟨fun {p} w => ((he p w).taken (hF.base w)).mono (by linarith),fun i p q w => ?_, fun i j p q r w => ?_⟩
  · exact (((he q w.basic).taken (hF.detail i w)).plus ((H1 _ w.added).pay (h.detail i w))).mono (by linarith)
  have h1 := (H2 j _ _ w.roads).pay (h.detail i w.oneWay)
  have h2 := (H2 i _ _ w.proceed).pay (h.detail j w.second)
  rw [add_assoc] at h1; rw [add_right_comm,add_assoc] at h2
  exact (((((he r w.oneWay.basic).taken (hF.stamp i j w)).plus h1).plus h2).plus ((H1 _ w.total).pay (h.stamp i j w))).mono (by linarith)

proof_context.conclusion: `tripleFilm U` gets `Ledger` budget `20*C*C*D` with one factor in the trace-dual `bags` norm (`D`) and two in `serial` (operator-type) norms, through two insertions.

lemma thin_pay (p : Momentum) (l : Site L) (hl : Odd L.val) (hp : p∈strip (1/128:ℝ)) (hv : Nave p) : ‖damp (inch L) (aliasAt p l)‖ ≤ 2*((pdist l+1:ℝ)^2)⁻¹ := by
  rcases eq_or_ne l 0 with hl'|hl'
  · subst l
    have h : pdist (0:Site L)=0 := by simp [pdist,Lattice.lift]
    simpa [h] using soda_pay_t (inch_pos L) (inch_le L) (alias_inside hp (0:Site L))
  let η := inch L; have hx : 0<η := inch_pos L
  have hw := hv.heights hl' hl
  let n : ℝ := pdist l; have hn : 1 ≤ n := by unfold n; exact_mod_cast pdist_pos hl'
  have hh : (n+1)*η ≤ shadeK (aliasAt p l) := by unfold n η at *; nlinarith
  let D := ‖soda η (aliasAt p l)‖
  have hd : (1/2:ℝ)*((n+1)*η)^2 ≤ D := (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_trans (pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) hh 2) (le_add_of_nonneg_right (sq_nonneg _))) (by norm_num)).trans (soda_safe_cube (inch_pos L) (inch_le L) (alias_inside hp l))
  have hD : 0<D := lt_of_lt_of_le (by positivity) hd
  rw [damp,norm_mul,norm_pow,norm_inv, norm_real,Real.norm_of_nonneg (inch_pos L).le]; change η^2 * D⁻¹ ≤ 2*((n+1)^2)⁻¹
  rw [← div_eq_mul_inv,← div_eq_mul_inv, div_le_div_iff₀ hD (by positivity)]; nlinarith only [hd]

proof_context.conclusion: The alias lower bound on `soda` (via `Nave p`, i.e. xi in [-pi,pi]^4, and `hv.heights`) gives the decay of `damp` at nonzero aliases.
